testcase.system-out: Scenario: Hide and show a solid using the active view commands ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the user copies Primary as BrowserView and activates the copied view ✔ And The MCAD Software has a part containing one solid body ✔ And a copied view is active ✔ And the solid body is visible ✔ When the user chooses All Hidden from the active view context menu ✔ Then the solid body is not displayed in the viewport ✔ And the solid body and its extrusion remain in the model browser ✔ When the user chooses All Visible from the active view context menu ✔ Then the solid body is displayed in the viewport ✔ And the solid body and its extrusion remain in the model browser
